create.name: Dr. Sharon Blackie
create.bio:
Sharon Blackie is a British writer and teacher whose work brings together myth, folklore, psychology and the natural world. She trained first as a scientist, taking a degree in psychology and a doctorate in behavioural neuroscience, and later turned to Celtic and European story traditions. The Royal Society of Arts made her a Fellow, the UK Association of Jungian Analysts gave her honorary membership, and she teaches online for Pacifica Graduate Institute.

She is best known for If Women Rose Rooted, a 2016 book that reads British and Celtic myth as a guide for women's spiritual lives and their bond with the land; Hagitude and Wise Women carry that inquiry into the later decades of life, and Ripening (2026) asks what fairy tales offer in uncertain times. She leads talks, courses and retreats on what she calls the mythic imagination, has taught at Esalen, the Garrison Institute and the Rowe Center, and gives a TEDx talk on the theme. Her current projects are The Art of Enchantment, a newsletter and membership community with salons and short courses, and Nostos, a programme exploring older Western contemplative traditions alongside depth psychology. She lives in Cumbria.

books.title: If Women Rose Rooted
books.author: Sharon Blackie
books.description: Her best-known book mixes memoir with British and Celtic myth to map a path for women back to a sense of belonging to the land. Each stage of the journey is framed through an old story.

books.title: Hagitude: Reimagining the Second Half of Life
books.author: Sharon Blackie
books.description: Drawing on myths and folk tales of older women, this book offers images of the elder years as a time of creativity, authority and depth rather than decline.

books.title: Wise Women: A New Mythology for Older Women
books.author: Sharon Blackie
books.description: A gathering of retold stories and reflections about women in later life, from wise old figures of folklore to the archetypes she sees as needed today.

books.title: The Enchanted Life: Unlocking the Magic of the Everyday
books.author: Sharon Blackie
books.description: An invitation to live with more wonder, using myth, creativity and attention to place to recover a sense that the world around us is alive.

books.title: Foxfire, Wolfskin and Other Stories of Shapeshifting Women
books.author: Sharon Blackie
books.description: A collection of her own retellings of folk and fairy tales about women who change shape, each followed by a short reflection on what the tale can mean now.

courses.title: The Art of Enchantment (premium membership)
courses.description: Her online community and publication. Paid members join myth and fairy-tale salons, short courses and masterclasses, summer schools and a forum, with recordings and her archive.

courses.title: Sisters of Root and Leaf: a women's retreat
courses.description: A residential women's retreat at Broughton Sanctuary in North Yorkshire. Through story, song and time on the land, participants explore the archetypal paths open to women in unsettled times, with folk singer Emily Portman as guest.
